note: Voice variety from three staffs with their own drone, one per block, each in a new key and scale: a short leap drill in major, then made-up calls and answers in minor, then a made-up tune in Mixolydian. Each staff shows only the notes in play; only the first block is a bare drill.

exercise.title: 4ths and 5ths in three scales
exercise.focus: Leaps of a 4th and 5th over a drone · F major · D minor · G Mixolydian
exercise.why: A leap lands in tune once you hear the landing note first, so practise landings over a drone.

sections.text: Press Start below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows on the staff. On "ah", sing {{1}} up to {{4}}, then {{1}} up to {{5}}. Hear the landing note in your head before you sing it.

Press Start below to start the drone on D and the mic. The same leaps now sit in D minor, with {{b3}} added. Sing a short call that leaps up from {{1}}, then answer it with a different leap that ends on {{1}}. Change vowel between the two: the call on "oo", the answer on "ee".
G Mixolydian: make up a tune

Press Start below to start the drone on G and the mic. Make up a short tune from {{1}}, {{4}}, {{5}} and {{b7}}, leaping between them in any order. Move through the vowels as you go, "ee-oh-oo-oh-ah", and watch your pitch line land on each note.
